positive.description: Find a tracked container by container number.
positive.prompt: Find TGBU8848518 in my connected Terminal49 account and summarize its current status.
positive.expected_behavior: If the container exists, returns matching identifiers, status, shipping line (COSU), and available terminal information. Otherwise, clearly reports zero matches without inventing data.

positive.prompt: How many of my containers are in each status right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns counts of actively tracked containers grouped by current status and states when the count is truncated. Reports the total when known; otherwise, explains that the total is unknown and reports how many containers were counted.

positive.description: Find a company and list its containers.
positive.prompt: Find the customer named Acme in my Terminal49 account and show their containers.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up matching companies and their IDs, then lists containers filtered to that customer. If no company matches, says so instead of listing unfiltered containers.

positive.description: List the 10 most recently updated shipments without nested containers.
positive.prompt: Show my 10 most recently updated shipments. Don’t include nested containers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 of the most recently updated shipments with a page size of 10, include_containers=false, no carrier, status, or port filters, and no nested containers. Mentions pagination if present.

positive.description: Create a tracking request for a container that is not already tracked.
positive.prompt: Track TGBU8848518 with carrier SCAC COSU in my Terminal49 account.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the existing matching container, creates a tracking request, or clearly reports that no request was created because the number/carrier could not be resolved. It must not claim the container exists unless the account response confirms it.

negative.description: Do not trigger for an unrelated weather request.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Los Angeles tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for freight-rate purchasing or quoting.
negative.prompt: Book the cheapest trucking rate from Los Angeles to Phoenix.

negative.description: Do not trigger an unsupported destructive action.
negative.prompt: Delete all completed shipments from my account.

review.commerce_description: Terminal49 for ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments. Trade intelligence is enabled per account under the customer's existing Terminal49 agreement.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: track containers and shipments, review documents, update parties and custom fields on request, and research US ocean import markets with Terminal49.
